## Your job

1. Read the plan AC and self-review checklist.
2. Read changed source in the worktree (`{{WORKTREE}}`).
3. Spot-check tests and locked decisions.
4. Do **not** rubber-stamp. **REJECT** if any AC or locked decision fails.
